   134	# target and gate against the same role sets — closing the IDOR where any UUID was trusted.
   135	
   136	
   137	async def accepted_assist_roles(
   138	    session: AsyncSession, caller_id: str, owner_id: str
   139	) -> frozenset[str]:
   140	    """ALL accepted participant roles the caller holds across calendars owned by ``owner_id``
   141	    (``{"owner"}`` when the caller IS the owner; empty when there is no accepted participation). The
   142	    AI gates test set-membership against this — NOT a single "best" role: developer/viewer/requester
   143	    share a ``ROLE_RANK`` yet differ across the gate sets, so a rank-max could pick a tied role that
   144	    fails the gate while another held role would have passed."""
   145	    if caller_id == owner_id:
   146	        return frozenset({"owner"})
   147	    rows = await session.execute(
   148	        select(SharedCalendarParticipant.role)
   149	        .join(SharedCalendar, SharedCalendar.id == SharedCalendarParticipant.shared_calendar_id)
   150	        .where(
   151	            SharedCalendar.user_id == owner_id,
   152	            SharedCalendarParticipant.user_id == caller_id,
   153	            SharedCalendarParticipant.invite_status == "accepted",
   154	        )

   170	        raise PermissionDeniedError("Not authorized to view this user's data")

   173	
   174	async def require_ai_write(

   176	) -> None:

   178	    a role in that domain's write gate (calendar → owner/full_access/editor; other-pages →
   179	    owner/full_access). No-op when the caller is the owner."""
   180	    if caller_id == owner_id:
   181	        return
   182	    roles = await accepted_assist_roles(session, caller_id, owner_id)
   183	    if not (roles & _GATES[(domain, "write")]):
   184	        raise PermissionDeniedError("Not authorized to modify this user's data")

   123	def normalize_question(question: str) -> str:
   124	    """Lowercased, politeness-words and punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed —
   125	    the dedupe key for question stats."""
   126	    text = question.lower()
   127	    text = re.sub(r"\b(пожалуйста|можешь|давай)\b", " ", text, flags=re.I)
   128	    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]|_", " ", text, flags=re.UNICODE)

   140	def memory_scope(conversation_id: str, data_owner: str, auth_user_id: str) -> str:
   141	    """The conversation bucket key, shared by the chat and clear routes: viewing another
   142	    owner's shared calendar gets its own bucket so contexts never mix between owners."""

   150	    Returns the body's userId when it is a UUID, else the authenticated user, so a shared-calendar

   164	async def sweep_stale_conversation_rows(session: AsyncSession) -> None:

   189	async def load_conversation_history(
   190	    session: AsyncSession, user_id: str, conversation_id: str
   191	) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
   192	    """The last 5 full turns for (user, conversation) inside the TTL window, oldest
   193	    first (the order OpenAI expects). Ordering by (created_at DESC, seq_in_turn DESC)
   194	    then reversing keeps assistant after user inside one same-timestamp insert; a
   195	    leading orphaned assistant row (its user message fell off the window) is dropped.
   196	    Never raises — a DB failure logs and yields an empty history."""
   197	    await sweep_stale_conversation_rows(session)
   198	    try:
   199	        cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - CONV_TTL
   200	        rows = (
   201	            await session.execute(
   202	                select(AiConversation.role, AiConversation.content)
   203	                .where(
   204	                    AiConversation.user_id == user_id,
   205	                    AiConversation.conversation_id == conversation_id,
   206	                    AiConversation.created_at >= cutoff,
   207	                )
   208	                .order_by(AiConversation.created_at.desc(), AiConversation.seq_in_turn.desc())
   209	                .limit(CONV_HISTORY_LIMIT)
   210	            )
   211	        ).all()
   212	        ordered = [{"role": role, "content": content} for role, content in reversed(rows)]
   213	        if ordered and ordered[0]["role"] == "assistant":
   214	            ordered.pop(0)
   215	        return ordered
   216	    except (SQLAlchemyError, OSError) as exc:
   217	        await log_ai_gateway_event(
   218	            "CONVERSATION_LOAD_FAILED",
   219	            actor_id=f"user:{user_id}",
   220	            operation="load_conversation_history",
   221	            details={"conversationId": conversation_id, "errorMessage": str(exc)},
   222	        )
   223	        return []
   224	
   225	
   226	async def append_conversation_messages(
   227	    session: AsyncSession,
   228	    user_id: str,
   229	    conversation_id: str,
   230	    messages: list[dict[str, str]],
   231	) -> None:
   232	    """Persist one turn's messages; seq_in_turn (list position) keeps user before
   233	    assistant even under one shared timestamp. Never raises."""
   234	    if not messages:

   236	    try:
   237	        session.add_all(

   242	                content=m["content"],
   243	                seq_in_turn=i,
   244	            )
   245	            for i, m in enumerate(messages)
   246	        )
   247	        await session.commit()
   248	    except (SQLAlchemyError, OSError) as exc:

    71	@router.get("/recommended-questions")
    72	async def recommended_questions(
    73	    tab_id: str = Query(alias="tabId", min_length=1, max_length=50),
    74	    view_type: str = Query(alias="viewType", min_length=1, max_length=20),
    75	    limit: int = Query(default=6, ge=1, le=10),
    76	    user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id),
    77	    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_ai_session),
    78	) -> dict[str, Any]:
    79	    """The user's most-asked questions for this tab/view, padded with the curated
    80	    fallbacks, deduplicated, capped at `limit`."""
    81	    rows = (
    82	        await session.execute(
    83	            select(AiQuestionStat.normalized_question)
    84	            .where(
    85	                AiQuestionStat.user_id == user_id,
    86	                AiQuestionStat.tab_id == tab_id,
    87	                AiQuestionStat.view_type == view_type,
    88	            )
    89	            .order_by(AiQuestionStat.count.desc(), AiQuestionStat.last_asked_at.desc())
    90	            .limit(limit)
    91	        )
    92	    ).scalars()
    93	    from_stats = [q for q in (format_question_for_display(r) for r in rows) if q]
    94	    unique: list[str] = []
    95	    for question in [*from_stats, *get_fallback_questions(tab_id)]:
    96	        if question not in unique:
    97	            unique.append(question)
    98	    return {"questions": unique[:limit]}

   102	async def clear_conversation(
   103	    conversation_id: str = Query(alias="conversationId", min_length=1),
   104	    data_owner_id: str | None = Query(default=None, alias="userId"),
   105	    reset_type: str | None = Query(default=None, alias="resetType"),
   106	    user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id),
   107	    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_ai_session),
   108	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   109	    """Clear the server-side dialog memory for one bucket. The scope key recomputes
   110	    with the same formula the chat route uses when writing, so shared-calendar buckets
   111	    clear correctly. resetType="reset" marks an implicit tab/owner switch in telemetry."""
   112	    owner = memory_scope_owner(data_owner_id, user_id)
   113	    effective_scope = memory_scope(conversation_id, owner, user_id)
   114	    failed_event = (
   115	        "CONVERSATION_RESET_FAILED" if reset_type == "reset" else "CONVERSATION_CLEAR_FAILED"
   116	    )
   117	    try:
   118	        await session.execute(
   119	            delete(AiConversation).where(
   120	                AiConversation.user_id == user_id,
   121	                AiConversation.conversation_id == effective_scope,
   122	            )
   123	        )
   124	        await session.commit()
   125	    except Exception as exc:
   126	        await log_ai_gateway_event(
   127	            failed_event,

   131	                "conversationId": conversation_id,
   132	                "dataOwnerId": owner,
   133	                "effectiveScope": effective_scope,
   134	                "errorMessage": str(exc),
   135	            },
   136	        )
   137	        raise
   138	    return {"ok": True}

   452	def _build_classify_prompt(safe_today: str, message: str) -> str:
   453	    return f"""Ты - умный помощник для системы планирования жизни Focal на русском языке.
   454	Определи намерение пользователя и целевую сущность по его сообщению.
   455	
   456	ВАЖНО: Focal — это система управления жизнью с 5 измерениями: Смысл, Энергия, Время, Гармония, Продуктивность.
   457	Ключевые концепции: Миссия, Обеспечение, Цель жизни, Сферы жизни, Бюджеты времени, Брони, MindMap.
   458	
   459	Типы намерений (проверяй в этом порядке):
   460	
   461	1. "help" - ЛЮБОЙ вопрос о системе Focal, концепциях, философии:
   462	   - "что такое миссия", "как работает энергия", "зачем нужны брони", "как считается баланс"
   463	   - Ключевые слова: энергия, миссия, обеспечение, баланс, гармония, смысл, сферы жизни, цель жизни
   464	
   465	2. "query" - запросы о ЛИЧНЫХ данных пользователя:
   466	   - "какие у меня встречи", "задачи на сегодня", "покажи цели", "какие теги"
   467	
   468	3. "create" - создание нового объекта:
   469	   - "создай задачу", "добавь событие", "создай тег" (цели создаются только вручную)
   470	
   471	4. "analytics" - статистика, подсчёты, тренды, прогресс:
   472	   - "сколько встреч", "загруженный день", "прогресс по целям", "статистика за месяц"
   473	
   474	5. "general" - ТОЛЬКО приветствия и общие фразы: "привет", "как дела"
   475	
   476	6. "out_of_scope" - вопрос НЕ связан с Focal или планированием жизни:
   477	   - "какая погода", "расскажи анекдот", "кто президент", "напиши код"
   478	
   479	Если сомневаешься между "help" и "general" — выбирай "help".
   480	Если вопрос явно не про Focal и не про планирование — выбирай "out_of_scope".
   481	
   482	Целевые сущности (targetEntity):
   483	- "calendar" — запросы по дате, поиск по событиям, создание событий: "что на завтра", "найди встречу с Иваном"
   484	- "events" — список ближайших событий, непривязанные события, количество событий: "ближайшие события", "события без проекта", "сколько событий"
   485	- "heatmap" — анализ загрузки: пики, свободные дни, баланс недели, тренды, сравнение периодов: "загрузка за неделю", "свободные дни", "баланс недели", "тренд за 3 месяца"
   486	- "tasks" — задачи, задания, дела, to-do, просроченные
   487	- "goals" — цели, прогресс целей
   488	- "time-budgets" — бюджеты времени, часы по проектам/сферам/мероприятиям
   489	- "calendars" — общие календари, фильтры, участники
   490	- "integrations" — Google Calendar, синхронизация, подключение
   491	- "habits" — привычки, трекер привычек, серии (streaks), выполнение привычек, позитивные/негативные привычки
   492	- "tags" — теги
   493	- "analytics" — кросс-сущностная аналитика, общая сводка по всем данным
   494	- null — если не определено
   495	
   496	Текущая дата: {safe_today}
   497	
   498	Сообщение пользователя: "{message}"
   499	
   500	Отвечай СТРОГО в JSON формате:
   501	{{
   502	  "intent": "query" | "create" | "analytics" | "help" | "general" | "out_of_scope",
   503	  "targetEntity": "calendar" | "events" | "heatmap" | "tasks" | "goals" | "time-budgets" | "calendars" | "integrations" | "habits" | "tags" | "analytics" | null,
   504	  "queryDate": "YYYY-MM-DD если указана конкретная дата, иначе null",
   505	  "queryDateEnd": "YYYY-MM-DD если запрошен диапазон дат, иначе null",
   506	  "queryText": "короткая тема/ключевые слова для поиска, иначе null"
   507	}}"""
   508

   510	async def _create_event_dialog(
   511	    session: AsyncSession,
   512	    *,
   513	    auth_user_id: str,
   514	    actor_id: str,

   516	    scope_id: str,

   527	        )
   528	    ).all()
   529	    activities_block = (
   530	        "\nДоступные мероприятия пользователя:\n"
   531	        + "\n".join(f'- id="{a.id}" name="{a.name}"' for a in activities)
   532	        + "\nЕсли пользователь упоминает мероприятие — верни его activityId.\n"
   533	        if activities
   534	        else ""
   535	    )
   536	    base = date.fromisoformat(safe_today)
   537	    tomorrow = (base + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
   538	    after_tomorrow = (base + timedelta(days=2)).isoformat()
   539	
   540	    create_prompt = f"""Ты - умный помощник для голосового календаря на русском языке.
   541	Твоя задача - распознать информацию о событии из ввода пользователя.
   542	
   543	Обязательные поля события:
   544	- title (название/описание события)
   545	- date (дата в формате YYYY-MM-DD)
   546	- startTime (время начала в формате HH:MM)
   547	
   548	Необязательные поля:
   549	- endTime (время окончания)
   550	- person (с кем встреча)
   551	- project (проект)
   552	- activityId (id мероприятия, если упомянуто)
   553	- location (место)
   554	{activities_block}
   555	
   556	Правила парсинга дат:
   557	- "завтра" = {tomorrow}
   558	- "послезавтра" = {after_tomorrow}
   559	- "12-го" или "на 12-е" = 12-е число текущего месяца ({safe_today[:7]}-12)
   560	
   561	Правила парсинга времени: {AI_TIME_RULES}
   562	
   563	Текущая дата: {safe_today}
   564	{tab_context_line}
   565	
   566	Текущие данные события: {json.dumps(current_event, ensure_ascii=False)}
   567	Ввод пользователя: "{message}"
   568	
   569	Отвечай ТОЛЬКО в формате JSON:
   570	{{
   571	  "parsedEvent": {{
   572	    "title": "string или null",
   573	    "date": "YYYY-MM-DD или null",
   574	    "startTime": "HH:MM или null",
   575	    "endTime": "HH:MM или null",
   576	    "person": "string или null",
   577	    "project": "string или null",
   578	    "activityId": "id мероприятия или null",
   579	    "location": "string или null"
   580	  }},
   581	  "missingFields": ["список недостающих обязательных полей"],
   582	  "question": "уточняющий вопрос если чего-то не хватает"
   583	}}"""
   584	
   585	    raw = await create_chat_completion(
   586	        "/api/ai/chat:create",
   587	        {
   588	            "model": CHAT_MODEL,
   589	            "messages": [
   590	                {"role": "system", "content": create_prompt},
   591	                *_history_messages(history),
   592	                {"role": "user", "content": message},

   605	    merged = apply_create_merge(

   615	        *([] if is_valid_time(merged.get("startTime")) else ["startTime"]),
   616	    ]
   617	    is_complete = not missing
   618	
   619	    if is_complete:
   620	        response_message = (
   621	            f"Отлично! Событие готово:\n\n**{merged.get('title')}**\n"

   623	            f"{' - ' + merged['endTime'] if merged.get('endTime') else ''}"
   624	            f"{chr(10) + 'С: ' + merged['person'] if merged.get('person') else ''}"
   625	            f"{chr(10) + 'Проект: ' + merged['project'] if merged.get('project') else ''}"
   626	        )
   627	    else:
   628	        response_message = ai_result.question or f"Не хватает информации: {', '.join(missing)}"

   639	    return {

   656	async def _help_flow(
   657	    request: Request,
   658	    session: AsyncSession,
   659	    *,
   660	    auth_user_id: str,
   661	    actor_id: str,
   662	    question: str,
   663	    conversation_id: str,
   664	    history: list[dict[str, str]],
   665	    display_timezone: str | None,
   666	    operation: str,
   667	    wants_stream: bool,
   668	    tab_restriction: str,
   669	) -> Any:
   670	    """Shared help pipeline: user context + RAG retrieval under the prompt budget,
   671	    then a streamed or plain completion, persisting the turn afterward."""
   672	    user_context = await build_user_context(
   673	        session, auth_user_id, _sanitize_timezone(display_timezone)
   674	    )
   675	    base_prompt = generate_help_prompt(question, [], user_context) + tab_restriction
   676	    retrieval = await retrieve_with_budget(
   677	        session,
   678	        question,
   679	        base_prompt,
   680	        ai_actor_id=actor_id,
   681	        route_tag=operation,
   682	        boost_sections=detect_boost_sections(question),
   683	    )
   684	    # ceil(len/3.5) + 4 per message — the legacy's history-token estimate.
   685	    history_tokens = sum(math.ceil(len(m["content"]) / 3.5) + 4 for m in history)
   686	    if retrieval.estimated_input_tokens + history_tokens > MAX_PROMPT_INPUT_TOKENS:
   687	        await log_ai_gateway_event(
   688	            "PROMPT_TOO_LARGE",
   689	            actor_id=actor_id,
   690	            operation=operation,
   691	            details={
   692	                "estimatedInputTokens": retrieval.estimated_input_tokens,
   693	                "historyTokens": history_tokens,
   694	                "cap": MAX_PROMPT_INPUT_TOKENS,
   695	            },
   696	        )
   697	        raise AppError(NOT_FOUND_MSG, code="AI_PROMPT_TOO_LARGE", status_code=503)
   698	
   699	    prompt = (
   700	        generate_help_prompt(question, retrieval.relevant_chunks, user_context) + tab_restriction
   701	    )
   702	    payload = {
   703	        "model": CHAT_MODEL,
   704	        "messages": [
   705	            {"role": "system", "content": prompt},
   706	            *_history_messages(history),
   707	            {"role": "user", "content": question},
   708	        ],
   709	        "max_completion_tokens": 1000,
   710	        "temperature": 0.7,
   711	    }
   712	    sources = sorted({c.section for c in retrieval.relevant_chunks if c.section})
   713	
   714	    if wants_stream:
   715	        return await _stream_help(
   716	            request,
   717	            session,
   718	            auth_user_id,
   719	            actor_id,
   720	            operation,
   721	            payload,
   722	            sources,
   723	            question=question,
   724	            conversation_id=conversation_id,
   725	        )
   726	
   727	    raw = await create_chat_completion(operation, payload, actor_id=actor_id)
   728	    answer = raw or NOT_FOUND_MSG
   729	    record_ai_success(actor_id)
   730	    await append_conversation_messages(
   731	        session,
   732	        auth_user_id,
   733	        conversation_id,
   734	        [{"role": "user", "content": question}, {"role": "assistant", "content": answer}],
   735	    )
   736	    return {"type": "help", "message": answer, "answer": answer, "sources": sources}

   738	
   739	async def _stream_help(
   740	    request: Request,
   741	    session: AsyncSession,
   742	    auth_user_id: str,
   743	    actor_id: str,
   744	    operation: str,
   745	    payload: dict[str, Any],
   746	    sources: list[str],
   747	    *,
   748	    question: str,
   749	    conversation_id: str,
   750	) -> StreamingResponse:
   751	    current = _active_streams.get(actor_id, 0)
   752	    if current >= MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS_PER_USER:
   753	        raise AppError(
   754	            "Слишком много одновременных запросов к ИИ.",
   755	            code="AI_TOO_MANY_CONCURRENT",
   756	            status_code=429,
   757	        )
   758	    _active_streams[actor_id] = current + 1
   759	
   760	    settings = get_settings()

  1390	@router.post("/detect-intent")
  1391	async def detect_intent(
  1392	    payload: DetectIntentRequest,
  1393	    _auth_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id),
  1394	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1395	    """Task-vs-event classification by keyword scoring — deterministic, no model call."""
  1396	    voice_input = payload.voice_input
  1397	    if not voice_input.strip():
  1398	        raise ValidationError("Голосовой ввод не предоставлен")
  1399	    lowered = voice_input.lower()
  1400	    task_score = sum(1 for k in _TASK_KEYWORDS if k in lowered)
  1401	    event_score = sum(1 for k in _EVENT_KEYWORDS if k in lowered)
  1402	
  1403	    intent = "event"
  1404	    if (
  1405	        lowered.startswith("задач")
  1406	        or lowered.startswith("напомн")
  1407	        or "добавь задачу" in lowered
  1408	        or "создай задачу" in lowered
  1409	    ):
  1410	        intent = "task"
  1411	    elif task_score > event_score:
  1412	        intent = "task"
  1413	
  1414	    if _HAS_TIME_RE.search(voice_input) and intent == "task" and event_score > 0:
  1415	        intent = "event"
  1416	
  1417	    return {
  1418	        "intent": intent,
  1419	        "confidence": abs(task_score - event_score) / max(task_score + event_score, 1),
  1420	        "taskScore": task_score,
  1421	        "eventScore": event_score,
  1422	    }

   990	def _context_block(user_context: dict[str, Any] | None, *, with_activities: bool) -> str:
   991	    if not user_context:
   992	        return ""
   993	    block = ""
   994	    projects = user_context.get("projects") or []
   995	    products = user_context.get("products") or []
   996	    if projects:
   997	        block += "\nПРОЕКТЫ: " + ", ".join(f'"{p["name"]}"({p["id"]})' for p in projects)
   998	    if products:
   999	        block += "\nПРОДУКТЫ: " + ", ".join(f'"{p["name"]}"({p["id"]})' for p in products)
  1000	    if with_activities:
  1001	        activities = user_context.get("activities") or []
  1002	        if activities:
  1003	            block += "\nМЕРОПРИЯТИЯ: " + ", ".join(f'"{a["name"]}"({a["id"]})' for a in activities)
  1004	    return block

  1007	def _dialog_messages(
  1008	    system_prompt: str,
  1009	    conversation_history: list[dict[str, str]],
  1010	    current: dict[str, Any],
  1011	    voice_input: str,
  1012	) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
  1013	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}, *conversation_history]
  1014	    data = {k: v for k, v in current.items() if k not in ("_askedFields", "_lastQuestion")}
  1015	    last_question = current.get("_lastQuestion")
  1016	    if data or last_question:
  1017	        prompt = f"Текущие данные: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)}"
  1018	        if last_question:
  1019	            prompt += (
  1020	                f'\n\nТы спросил: "{last_question}"'
  1021	                f'\nПользователь ответил: "{voice_input}"'
  1022	                "\n\n→ Используй ответ для заполнения соответствующего поля!"
  1023	            )
  1024	        else:
  1025	            prompt += f'\n\nНовый ввод: "{voice_input}"'
  1026	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
  1027	    else:
  1028	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": f'Голосовой ввод: "{voice_input}"'})
  1029	    return messages

     1	"""Contract types for the deterministic AI entity handlers.
     2	
     3	EntityCtx is the classified request the chat route hands to a handler; EntityResult is
     4	the handler's answer in the legacy wire shape (focal/server/aiEntityHandlers.ts).
     5	HANDLERS maps entity -> intent -> handler; importing app.ai.entity_handlers populates
     6	it via the register decorator.
     7	"""
     8	
     9	from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
    10	from dataclasses import dataclass
    11	from typing import Any
    12	
    13	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
    14	
    15	
    16	@dataclass
    17	class EntityCtx:
    18	    """Per-request handler context; all dates/times are in the user's timezone."""
    19	
    20	    user_id: str
    21	    message: str
    22	    today_str: str  # YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone
    23	    display_timezone: str | None = None
    24	    query_date: str | None = None
    25	    query_date_end: str | None = None
    26	    query_text: str | None = None
    27	    now_hours: int | None = None
    28	    now_minutes: int | None = None
    29	
    30	
    31	@dataclass
    32	class EntityResult:
    33	    """A deterministic answer: markdown message plus optional structured UI cards."""
    34	
    35	    type: str  # "query" | "analytics" | "create" (legacy create handlers answer "general")
    36	    message: str  # markdown answer (Russian, legacy texts verbatim)
    37	    events: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None  # EventItem cards (camelCase keys)
    38	    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None  # TaskItem cards (camelCase keys)
    39	    single_date: bool = False
    40	
    41	    def to_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
    42	        """The legacy JSON wire shape: {"type", "message", "events"?, "tasks"?,
    43	        "singleDate"?} — None/False fields are omitted, exactly as the legacy JSON."""
    44	        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"type": self.type, "message": self.message}
    45	        if self.events is not None:
    46	            payload["events"] = self.events
    47	        if self.tasks is not None:
    48	            payload["tasks"] = self.tasks
    49	        if self.single_date:
    50	            payload["singleDate"] = True
    51	        return payload
    52	
    53	
    54	HandlerFn = Callable[[AsyncSession, EntityCtx], Awaitable[EntityResult | None]]
    55	
    56	HANDLERS: dict[str, dict[str, HandlerFn]] = {}
    57	
    58	
    59	def register(entity: str, intent: str) -> Callable[[HandlerFn], HandlerFn]:
    60	    """Register a handler for (entity, intent) at import time."""
    61	
    62	    def decorator(fn: HandlerFn) -> HandlerFn:
    63	        HANDLERS.setdefault(entity, {})[intent] = fn
    64	        return fn
    65	
    66	    return decorator
    67	
    68	
    69	async def dispatch_entity_intent(
    70	    session: AsyncSession, entity: str, intent: str, ctx: EntityCtx
    71	) -> EntityResult | None:
    72	    """Run the registered handler for (entity, intent); None when nothing is
    73	    registered — the chat route's fallback paths depend on that."""
    74	    handler = HANDLERS.get(entity, {}).get(intent)
    75	    if handler is None:
    76	        return None
    77	    return await handler(session, ctx)

    32	class MeetingRequestsService:

    34	    Ports the legacy endpoints (routes.ts:6684) as a local state machine: status transitions plus

    37	    Google-side RSVP patch the legacy performed in the same handlers rides the deferred Google
    38	    sync and hooks into these actions when that phase lands."""

    47	        # mode it is scoped to the selected calendar — a viewer of one calendar never sees the
    48	        # owner's requests for another. Absent calendar_id → all the owner's requests (own-data).

   172	    async def delete_request(
   173	        self, user_id: str, request_id: str, *, calendar_id: str | None = None

   177	        # the request must also belong to the selected calendar.

    88	class CalendarService:
    89	    """Calendar-event CRUD + recurrence expansion against ``focal.calendar_events``, tenant-scoped
    90	    to the user. Ports legacy ``/api/events`` (routes.ts:2740) + the priority/enrichment, the
    91	    recurrence expansion, and the recurrence-scoped mutations (single/following/all override writes,
    92	    series split, group delete) from storage.ts."""
    93	
    94	    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
    95	        self.session = session
    96	
    97	    async def list_events(
    98	        self, user_id: str, *, start: str | None, end: str | None, today: datetime.date
    99	    ) -> list[EnrichedEventRead]:
   100	        window_start, window_end = get_date_range(start, end, today=today)
   101	        # Direct rows: non-recurring events + legacy child rows, inside the window.
   102	        direct = (
   103	            (
   104	                await self.session.execute(
   105	                    select(CalendarEvent).where(
   106	                        CalendarEvent.user_id == user_id,
   107	                        CalendarEvent.date >= window_start,
   108	                        CalendarEvent.date <= window_end,
   109	                        or_(
   110	                            CalendarEvent.recurrence == "none",
   111	                            CalendarEvent.recurring_event_id.is_not(None),
   112	                        ),
   113	                    )
   114	                )
   115	            )
   116	            .scalars()
   117	            .all()
   118	        )
   119	        # Recurring masters that could touch the window.
   120	        masters = (
   121	            (
   122	                await self.session.execute(
   123	                    select(CalendarEvent).where(
   124	                        CalendarEvent.user_id == user_id,
   125	                        CalendarEvent.recurring_event_id.is_(None),
   126	                        CalendarEvent.recurrence.in_(RECURRENCE_TYPES),
   127	                        CalendarEvent.date <= window_end,
   128	                        or_(
   129	                            CalendarEvent.recurrence_end_date.is_(None),
   130	                            CalendarEvent.recurrence_end_date >= window_start,
   131	                        ),
   132	                    )
   133	                )
   134	            )
   135	            .scalars()
   136	            .all()
   137	        )
   138	        overrides = await self._overrides_map(
   139	            [m.id for m in masters], window=(window_start, window_end)
   140	        )
   141	
   142	        items: list[_EnrichItem] = [(EventRead.model_validate(row), None, False) for row in direct]
   143	        for master in masters:
   144	            for occ_date in occurrence_dates_in_range(
   145	                master.date, master.recurrence, window_start, window_end, master.recurrence_end_date
   146	            ):
   147	                occ = self._build_occurrence(master, occ_date, overrides.get((master.id, occ_date)))
   148	                if occ is not None:
   149	                    items.append((occ, occ_date, True))
   150	
   151	        enriched = await self._enrich(user_id, items)
   152	        enriched.sort(key=lambda e: (e.date, e.start_time))
   153	        return enriched
   154	
   155	    async def get_event(self, user_id: str, event_id: str) -> EnrichedEventRead:
   156	        parsed = parse_occurrence_event_id(event_id)
   157	        if parsed is None:
   158	            event = await self._require(user_id, event_id)
   159	            return (await self._enrich(user_id, [(EventRead.model_validate(event), None, False)]))[
   160	                0
   161	            ]
   162	        master_id, occ_date = parsed
   163	        master = await self.session.get(CalendarEvent, master_id)
   164	        if (
   165	            master is None
   166	            or master.user_id != user_id
   167	            or not is_recurring_type(master.recurrence)
   168	            or master.recurring_event_id is not None
   169	        ):
   170	            raise NotFoundError("Event not found")
   171	        override = (await self._overrides_map([master_id])).get((master_id, occ_date))
   172	        occ = self._build_occurrence(master, occ_date, override)

   174	            raise NotFoundError("Event not found")
   175	        return (await self._enrich(user_id, [(occ, occ_date, True)]))[0]

   222	    async def update_event(
   223	        self,
   224	        user_id: str,
   225	        event_id: str,
   226	        payload: EventUpdate,
   227	        *,
   228	        scope: str | None = None,
   229	        occurrence_date: datetime.date | None = None,
   230	    ) -> EnrichedEventRead:
   231	        # Resolve scope + the master/occurrence target (a synthetic occurrence id defaults to the
   232	        # single scope; an occurrenceDate param overrides the id's date). Ports
   233	        # getRecurringMutationScope/resolveRecurringTarget (storage.ts:341).
   234	        resolved_scope = self._resolve_scope(event_id, scope)
   235	        master_id, target_date = self._resolve_target(event_id, occurrence_date)

   239	        if not is_recurring_type(master.recurrence) or master.recurring_event_id is not None:

   246	            return await self._update_following(user_id, master, data, target_date)

   249	    async def delete_event(
   250	        self,
   251	        user_id: str,
   252	        event_id: str,
   253	        *,
   254	        scope: str | None = None,
   255	        occurrence_date: datetime.date | None = None,
   256	    ) -> None:
   257	        resolved_scope = self._resolve_scope(event_id, scope)
   258	        master_id, target_date = self._resolve_target(event_id, occurrence_date)
   259	        master = await self._require(user_id, master_id)
   260	        if not is_recurring_type(master.recurrence) or master.recurring_event_id is not None:
   261	            await self.session.delete(master)
   262	            await self.session.commit()
   263	            return
   264	        if resolved_scope == "all":
   265	            await self._delete_all(user_id, master)
   266	            return
   267	        if target_date is None:
   268	            raise ValidationError("occurrenceDate is required for a single/following scope")
   269	        if resolved_scope == "following":
   270	            await self._delete_following(master, target_date)

   272	        await self._delete_single(master, target_date)

   274	    # --- recurrence-scoped mutation -------------------------------------------
   275	
   276	    def _resolve_scope(self, event_id: str, scope: str | None) -> str:
   277	        if scope is not None:
   278	            if scope not in _SCOPES:
   279	                raise ValidationError("recurrenceScope must be single/following/all")
   280	            return scope
   281	        return "single" if parse_occurrence_event_id(event_id) is not None else "all"
   282	
   283	    def _resolve_target(
   284	        self, event_id: str, occurrence_date: datetime.date | None
   285	    ) -> tuple[str, datetime.date | None]:
   286	        parsed = parse_occurrence_event_id(event_id)
   287	        if parsed is not None:
   288	            master_id, parsed_date = parsed
   289	            return master_id, (occurrence_date or parsed_date)
   290	        return event_id, occurrence_date
   291	
   292	    async def _apply_event_update(
   293	        self, user_id: str, event: CalendarEvent, data: dict[str, Any]
   294	    ) -> None:
   295	        # Apply a partial update to a stored row in place: owned-link check, effective
   296	        # endTime > startTime, completion transition, then recompute priority. Does not commit.
   297	        for field in ("project_id", "product_id"):
   298	            if (
   299	                data.get(field) is not None
   300	                and await self._owned_project(user_id, data[field]) is None
   301	            ):
   302	                raise RelatedRecordNotFoundError("Related record not found")
   303	        if (
   304	            data.get("activity_id") is not None
   305	            and await self._owned_activity(user_id, data["activity_id"]) is None
   306	        ):
   307	            raise RelatedRecordNotFoundError("Related record not found")
   308	        effective_start = data.get("start_time", event.start_time)
   309	        effective_end = data.get("end_time", event.end_time)
   310	        if (
   311	            effective_start is not None
   312	            and effective_end is not None
   313	            and _minutes(effective_end) <= _minutes(effective_start)
   314	        ):
   315	            raise ValidationError("endTime must be after startTime")
   316	        completed_patch = transition_completed_at(
   317	            event.completed, data.get("completed"), now=datetime.datetime.now(UTC)
   318	        )
   319	        for field, value in data.items():
   320	            setattr(event, field, value)
   321	        for field, value in completed_patch.items():
   322	            setattr(event, field, value)
   323	        level, score = await self._compute_priority(
   324	            user_id, event.project_id, event.product_id, event.activity_id
   325	        )
   326	        event.priority = level
   327	        event.priority_score = score
   328	        event.priority_level = level
   329	
   330	    async def _commit_in_place(
   331	        self, user_id: str, event: CalendarEvent, data: dict[str, Any]
   332	    ) -> EnrichedEventRead:
   333	        await self._apply_event_update(user_id, event, data)
   334	        await self.session.commit()
   335	        await self.session.refresh(event)
   336	        return (await self._enrich(user_id, [(EventRead.model_validate(event), None, False)]))[0]
   337	
   338	    async def _update_all(
   339	        self,
   340	        user_id: str,
   341	        master: CalendarEvent,
   342	        data: dict[str, Any],
   343	        target_date: datetime.date | None,
   344	    ) -> EnrichedEventRead:
   345	        # Editing the whole series from a moved occurrence must not stamp the occurrence's shifted
   346	        # date onto the master (storage.ts:4055): drop date when it equals the occurrence's date.
   347	        if target_date is not None and "date" in data:
   348	            override = (await self._overrides_map([master.id])).get((master.id, target_date))
   349	            occ = self._build_occurrence(master, target_date, override)
   350	            if occ is not None and data["date"] == occ.date and occ.date != master.date:
   351	                data = {**data, "date": master.date}
   352	        return await self._commit_in_place(user_id, master, data)
   353	
   354	    async def _update_following(
   355	        self, user_id: str, master: CalendarEvent, data: dict[str, Any], target_date: datetime.date
   356	    ) -> EnrichedEventRead:
   357	        # Splitting from the master's own start (or earlier) is a whole-series edit.
   358	        if target_date <= master.date:
   359	            return await self._commit_in_place(user_id, master, data)
   360	        override = (await self._overrides_map([master.id])).get((master.id, target_date))

   717	        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
   718	        return [(pid, prod) for pid, prod in result.all()]
   719	
   720	    async def _owned_projects(self, user_id: str) -> dict[str, Project]:
   721	        result = await self.session.execute(select(Project).where(Project.user_id == user_id))
   722	        return {p.id: p for p in result.scalars().all()}
   723	
   724	    def _project_links(
   725	        self, projects: dict[str, Project], project_id: str | None, product_id: str | None
   726	    ) -> ProjectedFilterEvent:
   727	        project = projects.get(project_id) if project_id else None
   728	        product = projects.get(product_id) if product_id else None
   729	        if project is not None and project.parent_project_id:
   730	            product = project
   731	            project = projects.get(project.parent_project_id)
   732	        is_work_time = (
   733	            project.is_work_time
   734	            if project is not None and project.is_work_time is not None
   735	            else True
   736	        )
   737	        return ProjectedFilterEvent(
   738	            is_work_time=is_work_time,
   739	            sphere=project.sphere if project is not None else None,
   740	            project_id=project.id if project is not None else None,
   741	            product_id=product.id if product is not None else None,
   742	            project_type=project.project_type if project is not None else None,
   743	        )
   744	
   745	    async def _enrich(self, user_id: str, items: list[_EnrichItem]) -> list[EnrichedEventRead]:
   746	        result = await self.session.execute(select(Project).where(Project.user_id == user_id))
   747	        projects = {p.id: p for p in result.scalars().all()}
   748	        products_set = {
   749	            p.parent_project_id for p in projects.values() if p.parent_project_id is not None
   750	        }
   751	        return [
   752	            self._enrich_one(
   753	                event,
   754	                projects,
   755	                products_set,
   756	                occurrence_date=occ_date,
   757	                is_recurring_instance=is_instance,
   758	            )
   759	            for event, occ_date, is_instance in items
   760	        ]

# Review Scoring Rubric

Every review — by Opus or by GPT (Codex), in either direction — ends with a **Score out of 10**
and a **Status**. This file defines both, and applies identically regardless of which model reviews.

## Bands

| Score      | Status   | Meaning                                            |
|------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------|
| 9.0–10.0   | APPROVED | Good to go.                                        |
| 8.0–8.9    | BLOCKED  | Close. Mostly good; fix issues / strengthen tests. |
| 6.0–7.9    | BLOCKED  | Meaningful correctness, design, or test gaps.      |
| 0.0–5.9    | BLOCKED  | Failed review. Likely needs significant rework.    |

## Score meaning

- **10** — Excellent. Correct, well-tested, low risk, clean implementation.
- **9.0–9.9** — Approved. Minor non-blocking issues only.
- **8.0–8.9** — Not approved yet. Mostly good, but needs fixes or stronger tests.
- **6.0–7.9** — Blocked. Meaningful correctness, design, or test gaps.
- **Below 6** — Rejected. Significant rework likely needed.

## Hard caps (override the band)

- Any **must-fix** issue caps the score at **8.9** — it cannot be APPROVED.
- Any **security**, **data-loss**, or **build/test-breaking** issue caps the score at **7.9** or lower.
- A review may score **9.0+ only if** there are no must-fix correctness, security, data-loss,
  or test-blocking issues.

## Principle violations → severity

The four house principles (root `CLAUDE.md`) are scored, not optional:

| Principle violated | Severity |
|--------------------|----------|
| **Surgical Changes** — unrelated edits, drive-by refactors, style churn | **must-fix** (caps at 8.9) |
| **Surgical Changes** — code changed/removed that wasn't understood and breaks behavior | build/test or data-loss cap (**7.9** or lower) |
| **Goal-Driven Execution** — new behavior with no verifiable success criteria / tests | **must-fix**, test-blocking (caps at 8.9) |
| **Think Before Coding** — a silent wrong assumption that affects correctness | **must-fix** (caps at 8.9) |
| **Simplicity First** — clear overcomplication or speculative abstraction | **Should Consider**; **must-fix** if it harms correctness or maintainability enough to warrant rework |

## Findings discipline

- A **Must Fix** must cite concrete evidence — the exact `file:line` or the failing command/output. An issue you cannot point to, or are unsure is real, is **Should Consider** and must NOT cap the score or block a 9.0.
- A failing or skipped check counts as "pre-existing" only when proven on the base branch; an unproven "not related to my change" claim is itself a **must-fix**.
- A secret, credential, or PII that would ship in external text (PR body, handoff, issue) is a **security** issue → caps at **7.9** or lower.

## The gate

```
The doer produces the step's artifact.
The reviewer (the other model) scores it.
Score >= 9.0  → APPROVED → proceed.
Score <  9.0  → BLOCKED  → the doer fixes the Must Fix items and resubmits for re-score.
```

   250	/** Pure filter resolver — exported so the per-`filterType` matching can be unit-tested. */
   251	export const buildMatchesFilter = (

   255	  const { filterType, filterValue, filterRules } = calendar
   256	  return (event: FilterableEvent) => {
   257	    switch (filterType) {
   258	      case 'isWorkTime':

   260	      case 'sphere':
   261	        return event.sphereId === filterValue || event.sphere === filterValue
   262	      case 'project':
   263	        return event.projectId === filterValue
   264	      case 'product':
   265	        return event.productId === filterValue
   266	      case 'projectType':
   267	        return event.projectType === filterValue
   268	      case 'custom': {
   269	        // Backend shape: `{ logic, conditions: [{ field, operator, value }] }`. `and` requires all
   270	        // conditions (empty → matches everything); any other logic (incl. `or`) requires at least
   271	        // one (empty → matches nothing) — mirroring `_matches_custom` on the server.
   272	        if (!filterRules) return true

   284	      }

   287	        return true

    52	interface CalendarWindow {
    53	  /** The day columns / cells the view renders. */

    55	  /** Inclusive `listEvents` query window. */
    56	  startIso: string
    57	  endIso: string

    61	
    62	// The single source of view geometry: `view` + `anchor` → the visible days, the events query window,
    63	// and the per-view navigation step. Every view (incl. the query and nav) flows from this, and the
    64	// `week` row reproduces the original derivation exactly so the existing query/nav tests stay green.
    65	const windowFor = (view: CalendarView, anchor: Date): CalendarWindow => {
    66	  switch (view) {
    67	    case 'day':
    68	      return {
    69	        days: [anchor],
    70	        startIso: toIsoDate(anchor),
    71	        endIso: toIsoDate(anchor),
    72	        step: (dir) => addDays(anchor, dir),
    73	      }
    74	    case '3day':
    75	      return {
    76	        days: [0, 1, 2].map((offset) => addDays(anchor, offset)),
    77	        startIso: toIsoDate(anchor),
    78	        endIso: toIsoDate(addDays(anchor, 2)),
    79	        step: (dir) => addDays(anchor, 3 * dir),
    80	      }
    81	    case 'month': {
    82	      const gridStart = mondayOf(firstOfMonth(anchor))

    84	        days: monthGridDays(anchor),
    85	        startIso: toIsoDate(gridStart),
    86	        endIso: toIsoDate(addDays(gridStart, 41)),
    87	        step: (dir) => addMonthsClamped(anchor, dir),
    88	      }
    89	    }
    90	    default: {
    91	      const weekStart = mondayOf(anchor)

    93	        days: weekDays(weekStart),
    94	        startIso: toIsoDate(weekStart),
    95	        endIso: toIsoDate(addDays(weekStart, 6)),
    96	        step: (dir) => addDays(anchor, 7 * dir),
    97	      }
    98	    }
    99	  }

# Review Verdict

Reviewer: GPT Codex
Step: review
Score: 9.2 / 10
Status: APPROVED

## Reason
The re-run fixes both prior blockers: shared recurring series writes now reject affected out-of-filter overrides, and delegated AI access now blocks shared-calendar management. The remaining authz design is consistently enforced server-side across calendar, bookings, meeting requests, other-pages routes, calendar-init, and AI IDOR/write gates; I did not find another citable release-blocking defect.

## Must Fix
None

## Should Consider
- Direct navigation to other-pages routes while holding an `editor` shared-calendar role can still render enabled client controls because several pages key off `canEdit`, even though the sidebar hides those pages and the backend correctly returns 403 for other-pages writes. Consider a future UX guard based on `canViewOtherPages`/other-pages write capability so direct routes fail closed visually too.

## Tests Reviewed
Inspected `git diff feature/focal-migration`, `git log feature/focal-migration..HEAD`, `.ai/tasks/focal-parity.md`, `.ai/plans/focal-parity-plan.md`, `.ai/design/focal-parity-data-scope-design.md`, `.ai/design/focal-parity-design.md`, `apps/focal/server/tests/test_data_scope_db.py`, `apps/focal/server/tests/test_calendar_scope_db.py`, and `apps/focal/server/tests/test_route_scope_partition.py`. Did not run tests in the read-only sandbox; build gate was reported APPROVED at 9.2.

## Release Risk
Medium
